title: After-sales case event data, version 1
description: The data of every after-sales event (after-sales-events topic): the after-sales case after the step the event reports, and the step itself (action, actor_type, actor_id). Every amount is in currency, the order's, and every line repeats it next to its amounts. Consumers that keep a copy of the case apply an event only when its version is above the one they hold.

order_id.description: The order's internal id, also the record key.

order_no.description: The order's public number as a string (it exceeds 2^53). Absent for an order without one.

restaurant_id.description: Absent only for the automatic refund of an order without a restaurant.

kind.description: CUSTOMER_REQUEST: the customer asked for a refund of a completed order. ORDER_CANCELLED: the automatic refund of a paid order that was cancelled.

attempt_no.description: 1, or 2 for the customer's request after withdrawing the first; always 1 for ORDER_CANCELLED.

status.description: The case status after the step; each event type fixes it.

action.description: The step: OPEN or ORDER_CANCELLED for the opening, otherwise the after-sales trigger, for example MERCHANT_APPROVE or OFFER_TIMEOUT.

actor_type.description: Who took the step; SYSTEM for the deadline poller, the refund executor and the cancellation of a paid order.

actor_id.description: The customer, merchant or admin login (customers.id) that took the step; absent for SYSTEM.

version.description: The case's version after the step: 0 when it was opened, then one more per step.

approved_amount.description: The amount to refund, from REFUNDING on.

currency.description: Currency of every amount of the case.

merchant_decision.description: The merchant's one answer, once given.

merchant_note.description: The merchant's reason for a rejection, or the note of a counter-offer.

resolution.description: How the approved amount was set, from REFUNDING on.

close_reason.description: Why the case was closed without a refund (CLOSED).

deadline_at.description: The deadline of an open status (PENDING_MERCHANT, COUNTER_OFFERED, REJECTED, IN_ARBITRATION); absent otherwise.

lines.description: The order lines the case asks a refund for; an ORDER_CANCELLED case lists every line in full.

quantity.description: The quantity asked, at most the quantity ordered.

currency.description: Currency of unit_price and amount: the case's currency.
